newsitem.title: USA: Fergie interviewing for job with Weight Watchers.
newsitem.headline: Fergie interviewing for job with Weight Watchers.

text.p: She may have blotted her copybook with the British Royal Family, but the Duchess of York could wind up with a big job in the United States.

Sarah Ferguson, who was once derided as "The Duchess of Pork" because of her portly demeanor, is now interviewing for a job as a spokeswoman for Weight Watchers -- a programme she follows and credits with helping her to lose weight.

A spokesman for Weight Watchers said the red-haired duchess, who was divorced this year from Britain's Prince Andrew after a series of scandals, is one of several prominent people under consideration for the job.
The New York Post quoted sources as saying the job could pay $1 million a year and could help to pay off some of the duchess's debts, which have been estimated at $4 million.
But the spokesman cautioned that it was too far too early for anyone to lick their chops -- no decision will be made until early next year.
He added, "There is a possibility we will pick her. She is an amazing personality. People respond to her."
The duchess's autobiography, "My Story", is to be published on Wednesday.
